scope: Local WordPress/MariaDB and REST regressions for mail/settings validation. Frontend limits share constants with PHP; JavaScript syntax checked. No real SMTP delivery, browser rerun, complete quality-ci, new coverage or QA deployment.
verified: Malformed SMTP text, nulls, control characters and disallowed port types are rejected before settings/secret/audit changes
Raw length is checked before trimming; UI receives shared limits
False clear flags are normalized in direct service calls as well as REST
Explicit clear remains supported in WordPress transport mode
Password 0 and leading/trailing password spaces survive encrypted storage; blank password preserves the old credential
Existing encrypted credentials, external secret management, delivery failures and transactional validation remain covered
The new email validation error is returned in English for an English administrator

cleanup.verified_with: Read-only local CLI query of the owned mailinput108_ prefix

progress.meaning: Requirement inventory, not acceptance certification, test coverage or an estimate of remaining effort
